item.tib: khro rgyal gar dbang rta mgrin gyi rgyan bkod 'phrul gyi me long gnad kyi byang bu
item.coloph: khro rgyal bder gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ rgyan bkod gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba/ stag la me 'bar gyi thugs bcud/ gyer spungs dran pa'i lung ston/ stang chen dmu tsa gyer med kyis/ phyi rabs las ldan gshen la brgyud pa dge legs 'phel//
